locator: II-II q.64 a.6 co. and ad 1
interpretation: The response contrasts innocent and righteous persons with sinners, argues that the life of the righteous advances the common good, and concludes the innocent must not be slain, but ad 1 explicitly treats one carrying out a divine command to kill an innocent person as not sinning. Read the general conclusion together with that qualification; this is not a source claim that every conceivable act description is exceptionless, nor a proof of a reason independent of ends.
